segments.name: Research
segments.evidence: Research provides over 1,900 scientific, technical, medical, and scholarly journals, as well as related content and services in areas of physical sciences and engineering, health sciences, social sciences and humanities, and life sciences.

segments.name: Learning
segments.description: Provides scientific, professional, and education print and digital books, digital courseware, and assessment services to students, instructors, professionals, and businesses.
segments.evidence: Learning includes the Academic and Professional reporting lines and consists of publishing, courseware, and assessments.

revenueModel.text: Libraries, institutions, and corporations pay subscription fees under multi-year agreements, authors or funders pay article processing charges for open access publishing, and customers pay licensing fees for content use including AI training.
revenueModel.evidence: APCs are typically paid by the individual author or by the author's funder, and payments are often mediated by the author's institution.
